settings.name: USE_MODSECURITY
settings.description: **Enable ModSecurity:** Turn on ModSecurity Web Application Firewall protection.

settings.name: USE_MODSECURITY_CRS
settings.description: **Use Core Rule Set:** Enable the OWASP Core Rule Set for ModSecurity.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_CRS_VERSION
settings.description: **CRS Version:** The version of the OWASP Core Rule Set to use. Options: `3` or `4`. Note: `nightly` is deprecated and defaults to v4.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_SEC_RULE_ENGINE
settings.description: **Rule Engine:** Control whether rules are enforced. Options: `On`, `DetectionOnly`, or `Off`.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_SEC_AUDIT_ENGINE
settings.description: **Audit Engine:** Control how audit logging works. Options: `On`, `Off`, or `RelevantOnly`.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_SEC_AUDIT_LOG_PARTS
settings.description: **Audit Log Parts:** Which parts of requests/responses to include in audit logs.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_SEC_AUDIT_LOG
settings.description: **Audit Log Path:** Path of the file ModSecurity writes audit entries to. Must be a regular file: the Serial audit writer locks it, which a pipe or stream can't support. The path must end in `.log`. Rotation via that suffix only applies where logrotate is installed (the Linux packages and the All-In-One image); on Docker, Swarm and Kubernetes a non-default name is neither streamed nor rotated and grows unbounded inside the container, because only `modsec_audit.log` is symlinked into the container's log stream.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_SEC_AUDIT_LOG_STORAGE_DIR
settings.description: Empty by default; required absolute storage directory for `Concurrent`.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_SEC_REQUEST_BODY_LIMIT
settings.description: Maximum inspected request body size, in bytes or with `k`/`m`/`g` suffixes. Empty derives from `MAX_CLIENT_SIZE`; NGINX enforces that limit first. `REVERSE_PROXY_MAX_CLIENT_SIZE` overrides this setting for its location. `0` removes the inspection limit and risks memory exhaustion.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_SEC_REQUEST_BODY_LIMIT_ACTION
settings.description: `Reject` returns HTTP 413 above the inspection limit. `ProcessPartial` inspects only the portion within the limit and forwards the full body, reducing WAF coverage. The separate no-files limit still applies.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_REQ_BODY_NO_FILES_LIMIT
settings.description: **Request Body Limit (No Files):** Maximum size for request bodies without file uploads. Accepts plain bytes or human‑readable suffix (`k`, `m`, `g`), e.g. `131072`, `256k`, `1m`, `2g`.

settings.name: USE_MODSECURITY_CRS_PLUGINS
settings.description: **Enable CRS Plugins:** Enable additional plugin rule sets for the Core Rule Set.

settings.name: MODSECURITY_CRS_PLUGINS
settings.description: **CRS Plugins List:** Space-separated list of plugins to download and install (`plugin-name[/tag]` or URL).

settings.name: USE_MODSECURITY_GLOBAL_CRS
settings.description: **Global CRS:** When enabled, applies CRS rules globally at the HTTP level rather than per server.
